after.zh: 在本关的白光模型里，光照强弱让 R、G、B 按相同比例变化。r = R ÷ (R + G + B) 不受这种明暗变化影响，是一种色度；光源颜色变化或接近全黑时，需要另作处理。HSV、Lab 等颜色空间也提供描述颜色和明暗的不同方式。
after.en: In this level's neutral-light model, changing light intensity scales R, G and B by the same factor. r = R ÷ (R + G + B) is a chromaticity unaffected by this brightness change; changes in light colour or near-black values require further treatment. Colour spaces such as HSV and Lab offer other ways to describe colour and lightness.

t.zh: 要找红色物体，单看 R 够吗？红苹果在阴影里可能比强光下的浅色苹果有更小的 R。先用两只苹果做实验，再让电路在整个场景里找红色。
t.en: Is R alone enough to find red objects? A red apple in shade can have a smaller R than a pale apple in bright light. First experiment with two apples, then build a circuit to find red throughout a scene.

t.zh: 先比较两只苹果各自的 R、G、B 图。滑动光照强度，观察三张图和数值怎么变化；灯是白光，只改变强弱。再选出红苹果。
t.en: First compare each apple's R, G and B images. Slide the light intensity and watch the three images and values change. The lamp is neutral white; only its strength changes. Then select the red apple.

brief.zh: 两只苹果的颜色不同，在同一盏白灯下。调节光照强度，比较各自的 R、G、B 图与数值，找出红苹果。
brief.en: Two differently coloured apples sit under the same neutral white lamp. Adjust the light intensity, compare their R, G and B images and values, and find the red apple.

hint.zh: 不要只比较两只苹果的 R；分别看看每只苹果的 R 与自己的 G、B 有什么关系，再改变光照试试。
hint.en: Do not compare only the apples' R values. Compare each apple's R with its own G and B, then change the light and try again.

after.zh: 在这个白光模型里，光照把同一个物体的三个通道按相同比例改变，因此可以比较通道之间的比例。接下来把这个想法用于整张图。
after.en: In this neutral-light model, illumination scales all three channels of the same object together, so their proportions can be compared. Next, apply the idea to a whole image.

win.zh: 找到了。比较每只苹果三个通道的相对大小，再试试不同的光强。
win.en: Found it. Compare each apple's three channels with one another, then try different light strengths.

status.zh: 比较各通道后选择苹果，再检查。
status.en: Compare the channels, choose an apple, and check.

brief.zh: 标出场景中所有红色区域，包括亮处和阴影里的红色区域。
brief.en: Mark every red area in the scene, including red areas in both light and shade.

hint.zh: 阴影里的红苹果，R 并不大；阳光下的白纸，R 却很大。光照把三个数一起放大缩小，什么量不受它影响？
hint.en: A red apple in the shade has a small R; white paper in the sun has a big one. Lighting scales all three numbers together, so what stays the same?
